findings.finding: Dossier says no live fee revenue was captured; the combined module now has separately captured DefiLlama winning-profit-fee aggregates. This is a collection-scope wording conflict, not independent verification of complete fees.
findings.requested_resolution: Qualify missing data as first-party official fee/accounting data and point to provider-defined profit fees in the business snapshot without treating them as total costs.

findings.finding: Each preflight limitations list repeats the same caveat five times. Caveat itself is accurate and does not conceal a scope upgrade.

resolutions.detail: October 15 date is attributed to mirror/media; original timestamp unverified. $1B is a relayed issuer notional claim, not independent volume/collateral reconciliation; The Defiant partial body is explicitly disclosed.

resolutions.check: YOLO House, fees and bilingual parity
resolutions.detail: House is separated from JLP; whole-claim FIFO is not given Papertrade partial-payment behavior. Deadband 0.00002 = 0.2bp and close charge at 1000x gives 0.098% bust distance; cap precedes 2% win fee. Exact nonlinear constant is only preflight source attribution because official bytes are missing.

Captured texts support opening-locked winning exposure, full adverse notional, partial-payment FIFO, cash versus unpaid claim separation, operator freeze powers and markup as a percentage of base fees. 200 ppm = 2bp; docs dynamic placeholders do not override supplier config. Cumulative stats.volume is not one-day volume.

resolutions.check: Trade Everything mechanism and business boundary
resolutions.detail: Captured texts support Papertrade-routing versus independent crypto-description conflict, half-order/half-pro-rata harvest and Draft status. Planned launch/live wording is not promoted to observed real trading; failed mainnet reads remain null.

resolutions.action: Checked first five YOLO source records: duplicated caveat reduced to one instance per limitations list
